MTech - Department of Electrical Engineering, IITGN

Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar
The department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar offers Master of Technology (MTech) programmes in the following disciplines.

Candidates can give preference for sub-specializations for MTech in Electrical Engineering. If offered, students will work on a thesis in the area of the selected sub-specialization. The degree offered is MTech (Electrical Engineering) with no specialization and students can be admitted through MTech (Regular), MTech (Early Admit) or MTech (Work and Study) programmes.  The following sub-specializations are offered for MTech in Electrical Engineering, for students admitted from 2025-26.
Power Engineering & Control Systems
Signal Processing & Machine Learning

Candidates can apply for MTech in Integrated Circuit Design & Technology. If offered, students will work on a thesis in the area of Integrated Circuit Design & Technology. The degree offered is MTech (Integrated Circuit Design & Technology) and students can be admitted through MTech (Regular), MTech (Early Admit) or MTech (Work and Study) programmes.
Integrated Circuit Design & Technology

Coursework Credits
42
Aarohan - 2 Credits
Writing - 4 Credits
4 credits of Applications of AI courses relevant to the discipline
Electives - At least 8 Credits
Courses specified by the Discipline - At least 16 Credits
[Please see discipline/sub-specialization pages for list of courses specified by the department for each disciplines/sub-specialization]
Thesis Credits
40
10 x 4 Credit Thesis Units
Other Requirements
Two courses of Physical Education are mandatory Pass/Fail courses. Fellowship (if eligible) will be usually released only after completion of Aarohan.
Physical Education - 2 Courses (Zero credit each)
Total
Credits
82
42 credits through coursework and 40 credits through thesis credits.
A maximum of 8 Credits from the Electives group can be at the undergraduate level (Course Code 5XX or below). All other courses MUST be at the postgraduate level (Course Code 6XX or above).
Pre-approved MOOCs, subject to approved credit limits, can be considered for courses from the Electives group.
